primary_tools.note: Use Systemia Yard / Evercraft Compute deployment and canary path. Do not substitute a third-party browser agent as the operating dependency.

prohibited_default_dependencies: external browser-agent providers used merely because Evercraft browser execution is temporarily gated
fallback_policy: If an Evercraft-owned execution capability is gated, record the blocker and advance activation of that capability. Do not silently replace it with a third-party operating dependency.
exception_policy: An external service may still be a distribution destination, evidence source, or user-authorized integration. That does not make it an Evercraft execution dependency.
browser_activation_gate: MCP discovery promoted only after production canary
